data.title: Cardano Tops Weekly Crypto Gainer Charts as ADA Soars 11% Over 7 Days — Bitcoin, Dogecoin Left in the Dust
data.description: Cardano (CRYPTO: ADA) emerged as the best-performing large-cap cryptocurrency last week, defying losses among the market’s heavyweights. Cardano Races to a 1-Month High ADA nearly rallied 11% in the last seven days, the highest among coins with at least $1 billion in market capitalization. ADA’s returns stood out against Bitcoin’s stagnation and Dogecoin’s sharp losses. The token climbed to a near one-month high during this period.
